title: ParGLU: Partial Gating Improves Language Modeling in MoE Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.20663v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multiplicative gating improves Transformer feed-forward networks (FFNs), but it reduces intermediate representation width under a fixed parameter budget. This trade-off is particularly relevant to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, where individual experts have limited capacity. We introduce ParGLU, a partially gated FFN that combines SwiGLU and ReLU$^2$ in two parallel branches. ParGLU matches the parameter count and principal matrix computation budget of conventional SwiGLU. We evaluate ParGLU in 30M, 75M, and 152M MoE language models using three random seeds per scale. ParGLU outperforms SwiGLU across all three seeds at 75M and 152M, reducing mean validation NLL by 0.0200 and 0.0249, respectively. Results at 30M are mixed. Controlled ablations show that increasing backbone width or expert width strengthens ParGLU's relative performance. Ablation studies further show that combining SwiGLU and ReLU$^2$ improves performance over either arc

translated_title: ParGLU：部分门控机制改进MoE Transformer的语言建模
translated_abstract: 乘性门控可以改进Transformer的前馈网络（FFN），但在固定参数预算下会降低中间表示的宽度。这种权衡对混合专家模型尤为重要，因为其中单个专家的容量有限。我们提出了ParGLU，一种在两个并行分支中结合SwiGLU和ReLU²的部分门控FFN。ParGLU在参数量和主矩阵计算预算上与传统SwiGLU相当。我们在30M、75M和152M的MoE语言模型上评估了ParGLU，每个规模使用三个随机种子。在75M和152M规模下，ParGLU在全部三个种子上均优于SwiGLU，平均验证负对数似然（NLL）分别降低了0.0200和0.0249。在30M规模下的结果则好坏参半。受控消融实验表明，增加主干网络宽度或专家宽度会增强ParGLU的相对性能优势。消融研究进一步表明，将SwiGLU与ReLU²结合使用比单独使用任一架构都能提升性能。
tldr: 提出ParGLU，一种将SwiGLU与ReLU²结合于并行分支的部分门控FFN，在参数量与计算预算不变的情况下显著提升MoE语言模型的性能。
en_tdlr: ParGLU, a partially gated FFN combining SwiGLU and ReLU² in parallel branches, improves MoE language model performance while matching the parameter and computation budget of conventional SwiGLU.
